_about: What the import report must say of a lab file (scripts/report-expect.js; the gate checks it). Codes: garbledText (a font's text is not language: lib/pdfimport/trust.js, the judge), hiddenText (text no reader sees, given in the hidden-text block), fontprintRead (a font's characters read from its outlines: the font arbiter). lostText (letters the layout dropped with no known reason: trust.js _lostOut, 3.1).

word-cover--glyph-index-fa._note: its two lines in the unknown font hold too few letters for the reading (3.2: 20 at least, unless another font of the page was read): still reported

driver-print--renumbered-en._note: DejaVu Sans renumbered: read by the shapes of its glyphs (3.2), recovered, approximate (garbled until 3.1; the owner's decision, 2026-11-19)

driver-print--unknown-serif-fa._note: FreeSerif, a typeface Kelk does not ship, renumbered: read by the shapes of its glyphs (3.2), recovered, approximate

driver-print--unknown-serif-en._note: Liberation Serif: its glyphs are further from the fonts Kelk ships (all sans for Latin) than the reading's limit, set on those fonts, allows — reported, not read (3.2)

driver-print--unreadable-fa._note: glyphs drawn as abstract bars: no reading can recover it, so it must always be reported garbled (the owner's rule, 2026-11-18)

distiller-cff--cff-cid-fa._note: a CID-keyed CFF font Kelk does not know, no ToUnicode: read by its shapes since the CFF outline reader (3.3: garbled before, turned around with the owner's approval, 2026-11-21); the judge still finds the body's reading odd (FreeSerif's alef read «أ»), so it is reported too

distiller-cff--cff-type1c-fa._note: a renumbered plain CFF font Kelk does not know (2048 units an em, subroutines): read by its shapes since the CFF outline reader (3.3); before, its codes came back as ASCII and nothing was reported

distiller-cff--cff-known-fa._note: Vazirmatn as a renumbered CFF font: known by its rough prints since the CFF outline reader (3.3); before, its codes came back as ASCII and nothing was reported

distiller-cff--cff-unreadable-fa._note: a CFF font of abstract bars: no reading can recover it, so it must always be reported garbled (the owner's rule for CFF fonts, 2026-11-21)

word-save--teh-fa._note: Word's ToUnicode names every ت «"»: the judge reports it until the fix from the font's own cmap (3.3); turned around then with the owner's approval

chrome-cutrow--cut-row._note: a table row cut by the page break, dropped with no reason (3.1): the report must say so
